_comment: Vulkan drivers the app bundles (app/src/main/assets/drivers) and the GitHub releases they come from. devtools/check-drivers.py compares each watched repo's newest matching release with 'release' here. After bundling a newer one, update release, md5, shown (the stats overlay's name, read by the app) and the date, and the names in app/src/main/assets/licenses/mesa.txt. A release build checks every driver's md5 (checkBundledFiles in app/build.gradle.kts).
